opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarship

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries or be in a position to influence these industries; aged between 25 and 45 (upper limit 45 on 31st July in the year of application); no academic qualifications required; well established in career, three years post tertiary education; resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or working directly for UK agriculture; not in full-time education and not for further research projects.
opportunities.summary: Awards approximately 25 individuals each year the opportunity to research topics of interest in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry. Scholars conduct a study tour anywhere in the world for no less than 8 weeks, and on return present findings in a written report, video and a presentation at the Nuffield Farming Conference. A £9,000 bursary is given towards study tour and subsistence, plus professional and leadership development (induction, conference tickets, Industry leaders seminar, CSC attendance, professional development training and networking).

opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1,000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the dairy industry or in regenerative agriculture.
opportunities.summary: A 30-day study programme aimed at young people aged 18-24 to develop young talent in the industry, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. The 2027 programme runs dairy and regenerative agriculture study tours (June/July), fully funded including all travel, subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. The 2027 applications open in November 2026.
